name: oc-ai-report
description: Cross-ticket AI-usage report over a period - AI-metrics JSON records (backend/frontend/QA) grouped by developer domain; per-area estimate hours from the Story's Architect/QA estimate custom fields (else ticket estimate); bug counts and hours-logged-on-bugs per area; logged hours per user & ticket via the Tempo API (fallback Jira worklogs); time gain; Totals = sum of details. Prints Markdown and writes a self-contained styled, date-stamped HTML file to ./docs/ai-usage-report-<date>.html. Reads Jira (Atlassian MCP) + optional Tempo (TEMPO_API_TOKEN).
